rows.name_as_written: Cooperative Health Research in South Tyrol study
rows.quote: To illuminate the complement's genetic underpinnings, we conduct genome-wide association studies of the functional activity of the classical (CP), lectin (LP), and alternative (AP) complement pathways in the Cooperative Health Research in South Tyrol study (n = 4,990).
rows.dataset_named_in_source: Cooperative Health Research in South Tyrol study
rows.coder_note: Sentence names the study in which the paper's own GWAS were run; the dictionary has no row for it.
